# `api.jobs.shipment.cancel`

> `PUT /job/{jobDisplayId}/shipment/cancel/{quoteId}` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.jobs.shipment.cancel(job_display_id: int, quote_id: str, **kwargs: Any) -> ShipmentCancelResult
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab jobs shipment cancel <job_display_id> <quote_id> [--body ...]
```

Cancel the shipment identified by a quote UUID; preserves other shipments.

## Request body — `CancelShipmentRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobModifiedDate` | `Optional[datetime]` | no | Last observed job modification timestamp for optimistic concurrency. |
| `forceUpdate` | `bool` | no | Allow an overwrite-policy conflict override; refresh-policy conflicts still require a fresh read. |
| `forceDelete` | `bool` | no | Force cancellation only when explicitly requested. |

|---|---|---|---|

| `errorMessage` | `Optional[str]` | no | Error message. |
| `jobModifiedDate` | `Optional[datetime]` | no | Last observed job modification timestamp for optimistic concurrency. |
| `overrideError` | `Optional[bool]` | no | Override error. |
